personality: 1 iOS-Native Clean structure with 6 Glass / Luxe surfaces in dark mode
personality_one_liner: A professional, clean, and elegant inventory management tool that feels native and trustworthy, shifting to cinematic glass depth in dark mode.

spacing.rule: Generous vertical padding, single-column forms with sticky CTAs, and strictly aligned 2-column grids for dashboard tiles.

do's: Use on sticky headers over scrolling content
Use on the bottom tab bar
Apply dark mode glass on surfaceSecondary cards over the abstract blue background
dont's: Do not blur form fields or dense text areas
Do not use on low-end Android devices

screens.name: Onboarding
screens.purpose: Initial setup asking only for the user's name without password.

states.empty: Clean full-screen form with a single large text input.
states.error: Inline red text below input if name is empty.

screens.layout: Full bleed layout. A subtle gradient background. Large greeting typography (display font, 2xl). Centered single text input with 'surfaceTertiary' background, no border. Sticky 'Continuar' button at the bottom safely above the indicator.

screens.name: Home (Categorías)
screens.purpose: Main dashboard displaying product categories and access to global search.

states.empty: Empty cardboard box image, text 'No hay categorías registradas', and a primary CTA 'Añadir Categoría'.
states.error: Centered error message with Retry button.

screens.layout: Sticky header with user greeting. A 2-column grid for categories (wrap with space-between). Each category card uses 'surfaceSecondary' with a large tinted icon container. FAB at bottom right to add a new category with glass blur.

screens.name: Category Details (Marcas)
screens.purpose: Displays auto-generated brands within a selected category.

states.empty: Empty state illustration with text 'Aún no hay marcas en esta categoría'.

screens.layout: List view. Each row displays the brand name as a subcategory. Use standard leading visual (initials if logo absent) + title + chevron right. Minimum 56pt height per row.

screens.name: Product List
screens.purpose: Displays products under a specific brand.

states.empty: Empty box image with 'No hay productos de esta marca'.

screens.layout: Scrollable list. Each row shows Product Name, SKU (muted), and Base Price (S/ es-PE format). FAB to add a new product.

screens.name: Product Form
screens.purpose: Register or edit a product with dynamic colors and live warranty calculation.

states.error: Toast or inline text for validation (e.g., missing price).

screens.layout: Single-column scrollable form. Labels above inputs. Dynamic color section: a 'surfaceSecondary' container where users can tap 'Add Color' to append new surfaceTertiary blocks containing Name and SKU inputs. A pinned bottom container (using glassmorphism) showing live Warranty Price calculation based on inputted price, alongside the sticky 'Guardar' button.

screens.name: Product Detail
screens.purpose: View product info, select color, and see price breakdown (Product + Warranty = Sum).

states.error: Retry state if product load fails.

screens.layout: Top hero section featuring a tinted gradient or brand logo. Below, product title and SKU. Color selection via 'brandTertiary' tinted chips. A clear, segregated price breakdown card displaying: Base Price, Warranty Price, and a prominent SUMA (Total) in 'brandPrimary'. Bottom sheet or modal for delete action (centered 'Sí'/'No').

screens.name: Configuración
screens.purpose: Manage categories and warranty rules based on price ranges.
screens.layout: Standard iOS-style settings list. Grouped rows with 'surfaceSecondary' cards. Tinted icon containers on the left of each row. Sections for 'Categorías' and 'Reglas de Garantía'.

empty_state_box.alt: Empty open cardboard boxes representing zero inventory

hero_background.alt: Abstract blue gradient background for hero cards

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure dark mode and light mode are both fully supported as requested by the user. The app should launch into an empty state ('empezar vacío').
Use the explicit professional blue ('azul profesional') tokens provided, bypassing the default ban because the user specifically requested it.
Implement Peruvian Soles format (S/ ) for all monetary values.
The Warranty price logic must dynamically update within the product form as the base price changes, placing this in a sticky bottom container.
Use centralized modals for deletions with simple 'Sí'/'No' options as requested.
Brands are auto-generated from the 'Marca' field of products. Do not make a separate form for Brands; derive them from the products within a category.
Do NOT use emojis anywhere in the app UI.
Follow 44x44pt touch targets rigorously for all list chevrons and form inputs.
